# 7483 - 4-bit binary full-adder

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7483.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7483.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 18 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7483 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7483.png) | ![7483 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-7483.png) | ![7483 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-7483.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 9 | S1 = A1 XOR B1 XOR C0 | Sum bit 1 (datasheet name: sigma 1). |
| 6 | S2 = A2 XOR B2 XOR C1, C1 = (A1 AND B1) OR ((A1 XOR B1) AND C0) | Sum bit 2. C1 is the internal carry out of bit 1. |
| 2 | S3 = A3 XOR B3 XOR C2, C2 = (A2 AND B2) OR ((A2 XOR B2) AND C1) | Sum bit 3. C2 is the internal carry out of bit 2 (named in the function table note). |
| 15 | S4 = A4 XOR B4 XOR C3, C3 = (A3 AND B3) OR ((A3 XOR B3) AND C2) | Sum bit 4. |
| 14 | C4 = (A4 AND B4) OR ((A4 XOR B4) AND C3) | Carry out: C4,S4,S3,S2,S1 = A4..A1 + B4..B1 + C0 in binary. Internally the carry is looked ahead across all four bits (datasheet), so the value is the same as this ripple formula but the delay is not ripple delay. |

| C0 | S1,S2,S3,S4 | PHL | 12 | 21 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| Ai,Bi | Si | PLH | 16 | 24 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| Ai,Bi | Si | PHL | 16 | 24 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| C0 | C4 | PLH | 9 | 14 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 780 ohm |
| C0 | C4 | PHL | 11 | 16 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 780 ohm |
| Ai,Bi | C4 | PLH | 9 | 14 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 780 ohm |
| Ai,Bi | C4 | PHL | 11 | 16 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 780 ohm |

## Not known

- Delay from Ai/Bi to a higher sum bit (for example A1 to S4): the table lists only Ai/Bi to Si (same bit) and to C4.

## Notes

Datasheet pin names use the Greek sigma for the sum outputs; written S1-S4 here. The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.

## Sources

- [TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, section 7 (MSI/LSI data sheets)](https://bitsavers.mirrorservice.org/components/ti/_dataBooks/1976_TI_The_TTL_Data_Book_2ed/07.pdf) - 7-52 to 7-55 (PDF pages 52-54); SN7483A (the 1976 book lists only the A version of the plain 74 part)
